meta_rows: Prefer not to say what the total take-home income is for participant and their partner at the time of the Coronavirus outbreak in March 2020 - Covid wave 3 (age 75 years)

Questions about participants financial situation - Covid wave 3 questionnaire. This question was not asked in waves 1 and 2. This applies to those asked in the postal. Separate variables exist for those asked online
cat_rows: This category contains data about finance, education and employment the participant was doing before and since the coronavirus outbreak asked in the 2020-2021 covid questionnaires where the participant was 74 years.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
